bioAdditions: Frederick appears in the 1820 census of Plymouth as 'Frederick Crapp' (an indexing of Croup), with a large family including two young men, two girls aged 10-15 and a young woman (S1); Elizabeth (b. c.1802) and her sisters fit those columns. In 1840 'Fred'k Croup' was still in Plymouth Township, a man in his seventies with a wife in her sixties and a younger couple, probably a married child, living with them (S2). His will is in the county index as 'Croup, Frederick, Plymouth Twp., 1841', recorded in Will Book B at page 80 (S3); the FamilySearch tree dates his death to before 10 April 1841 (S4). The will itself has not been transcribed online; it should name his children, including Elizabeth Pringle and Susan Shupp.

openQuestionsResolved.question: Luzerne Orphans' Court and wills for Frederick Croup (d. 1841) - should name all children incl. Elizabeth Pringle.
openQuestionsResolved.answer: The will exists: Luzerne Will Book B p.80 (Plymouth Twp., 1841). Text not online; it is in the FamilySearch Luzerne will-book images (login needed) or at the Register of Wills.
